scenarios.title: Webhook backlog
scenarios.description: Delivery latency rises after a worker deployment.

events.message: Deployment d-104 reduced worker concurrency from 8 to 1.
Queue depth increased from 40 to 1800; incoming rate remained 60 events per minute.
Delivery p95 increased from 2 seconds to 95 seconds.
Downstream endpoint success rate remained 99.9%; worker error count was 0.

runbook.title: Queue saturation / v1.0
runbook.text: Compare arrival rate, worker concurrency and processing duration. Check downstream failures before proposing capacity changes.

scenarios.title: Failing dependency
scenarios.description: Checkout requests fail while a pricing dependency times out.

events.message: Checkout release remained unchanged at d-88.
Trace t-201: pricing-api timed out after 3000 ms; checkout returned 502.
Trace t-202: pricing-api timed out after 3000 ms; checkout returned 502.
Pricing dependency timeout rate reached 38%; database latency remained 12 ms.

runbook.title: Dependency timeout / v1.0
runbook.text: Correlate failing traces with dependency timings. Check timeout rates and recent changes. Do not infer the dependency root cause from caller traces alone.

scenarios.title: Duplicate delivery
scenarios.description: A retried event creates a repeated downstream action.

events.message: Event evt-42 delivery attempt 1 committed action act-101.
Acknowledgement for evt-42 attempt 1 timed out after commit.
Event evt-42 delivery attempt 2 committed action act-102.

runbook.title: Duplicate handling / v1.0
runbook.text: Compare stable event IDs and committed action IDs across attempts. Confirm idempotency enforcement; preserve records for review.

scenarios.title: Insufficient evidence
scenarios.description: A latency alert arrives with a gap in trace collection.

events.message: Order latency p95 increased from 200 ms to 1700 ms.
Trace collection unavailable for the alert window.
No deployment record is available for the alert window.

runbook.title: Incomplete telemetry / v1.0
runbook.text: State what is observed. List missing signals. Do not select a root cause without supporting evidence.

backlog.hypothesis: Reduced concurrency may explain the backlog; verify processing duration before changing capacity.

observations.quote: Deployment d-104 reduced worker concurrency from 8 to 1.
Queue depth increased from 40 to 1800; incoming rate remained 60 events per minute.
Delivery p95 increased from 2 seconds to 95 seconds.
Downstream endpoint success rate remained 99.9%; worker error count was 0.

missing_evidence: Worker CPU and processing duration are not present.
A controlled concurrency restoration has not been observed.
next_steps: Compare arrival rate, worker concurrency and processing duration. Check downstream failures before proposing capacity changes.

dependency.hypothesis: Pricing timeouts may explain caller failures; the dependency root cause remains unknown.

observations.quote: Checkout release remained unchanged at d-88.
Trace t-201: pricing-api timed out after 3000 ms; checkout returned 502.
Trace t-202: pricing-api timed out after 3000 ms; checkout returned 502.
Pricing dependency timeout rate reached 38%; database latency remained 12 ms.

missing_evidence: The cause of the dependency timeout is not established.
next_steps: Correlate failing traces with dependency timings. Check timeout rates and recent changes. Do not infer the dependency root cause from caller traces alone.

duplicate.hypothesis: Retries without idempotency may explain the repeated action; the acknowledgement failure remains unexplained.

observations.quote: Event evt-42 delivery attempt 1 committed action act-101.
Acknowledgement for evt-42 attempt 1 timed out after commit.
Event evt-42 delivery attempt 2 committed action act-102.

missing_evidence: The acknowledgement network failure cause is unknown.
Other affected event IDs have not been checked.
next_steps: Compare stable event IDs and committed action IDs across attempts. Confirm idempotency enforcement; preserve records for review.

inconclusive.hypothesis: Evidence is insufficient to attribute a cause; collect request traces and dependency timings.

observations.quote: Order latency p95 increased from 200 ms to 1700 ms.
Trace collection unavailable for the alert window.
No deployment record is available for the alert window.

missing_evidence: Request traces, dependency timings and deployment records are missing.
Collect these signals before attributing a cause.
next_steps: State what is observed. List missing signals. Do not select a root cause without supporting evidence.
